alive.last_commit_message:
Count a parent project's subprojects by Work stage (#1288)

* Count a parent project's subprojects by Work stage

A parent's Work page counted only its own items, so a portfolio whose stage
items all sit on its subprojects read as empty in every stage. The page now
shows Subprojects by stage: for each stage, how many direct subprojects have
an item there and how their work stands (blocked, active, not started or all
done); a flagged stage none reached reads None yet. Selecting a stage filters
the Subprojects list to those that reached it, or with Not yet to those that
have not; the URL holds the choice so it survives reload.

The roll-up reads Core's shared work/items listing, which wakes no
subproject's worker. Docs, the settings assistant guide and catalog, and a
product-knowledge regression cover it; the real-Core inheritance journey now
checks the roll-up, filter, reload, layout and Axe.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Let keyboards reach the scrolling Work board; retry the first post-pair navigation

At the compact viewport a parent's empty status board scrolls sideways with
nothing focusable, which Axe reports as an unreachable scrollable region; both
boards now take focus. CI aborted the inheritance journey's first navigation
right after pairing on compact and chromium-430, while the paired shell was
still loading, so that navigation now retries.
